items.title: Albert "June" Gardner Interview, 1996-04-17
items.q: We used to work so much with just regular guys like Ray Tyler, Chuck, Eddie Collins, myself. We would have nine jobs in a week.

ctx.x: Or somebody who could play modern jazz, but you told them to play a blues?

Yeah, like a lot of these low rhythm and blues band, they had riffs that they would play. I mean Roy Brown had riff riff riff. Yeah, you know, that, that, da, da, da, da, da, da, you know. Right. It's simple, you know, if you start, play this, you know. Right. But uh, well, most overall it was a good band because like during those times we would play maybe an hour or so before he would even come on and sing. Oh, okay.
